entities.description: A scuttling heap of discarded lead printing blocks on spindly legs; no legible glyphs.
A brass pneumatic mail capsule with insect wings, pointed piston sting.
An empty detached civil-service sleeve animated around a rubber duty stamp, no flesh or gore.
A pale carbon-paper duplicate of a Victorian clerk, folded edges and hollow features.
entities.defeatMeaning: dissolves into loose paper sheets, no death or blood

entities.description: A grey rat with blank narrow filing strips tangled into its fur.
A faceless funicular brakeman in heavy uniform, brake lever and cable spool.
A low spilling ink shadow that rises into a bent humanoid silhouette.
A moving empty postal sack, stitched mouth, rope legs, blank shipping tag.
The Lead Collector, massive body of discarded lead type blocks, printing roller forearms, no readable letters.
The Blind Courier, towering eyeless postman, canvas mailbag and brass sorting arms, three blank address frames.
The Register Body beneath the archive: broad limestone foundation creature woven from erased signature-like abstract ink ribbons and blank register sheets; no writing.
A nurse made of pale steam, recognizable white nurse cap and copper valve hands.
A living confused Victorian patient in a gown, roots replacing hands, moss-green and bone-white.
entities.defeatMeaning: kneels then lies unconscious alive, roots relax

entities.description: A moth built from fogged pale green glass, copper veins, frost at wing tips.
A peach blossom with a subtle face and short root stem, pink petals reserved for flowers.
A crawling segmented copper heating pipe worm, elbows and a small valve head.
A dazed living spa guest in a dressing gown holding a blank postcard and pen.
entities.defeatMeaning: sits down unconscious but alive, postcard falls

entities.description: An apparition of swirling clean white laundry, clothespin details and copper steam.
A boiling copper cauldron on jointed legs, lid tilted, white vapor.
The Glass Gardener: a huge mobile grafting shear embedded in a plant body, fogged glass leaves and tied grafting threads.
The Breath Boiler: a dense towering mass of held sighs and white steam around an old copper laundry boiler, looped sheets.
The Blossom Mouth: a vast peach-flower mouth in intertwined warm roots beneath a dry mine, pale green glass fragments and copper pipes. No gore.
A Victorian highway robber with patched charcoal coat, scarf and wooden cudgel.
A translucent coach passenger ghost with an old carriage wheel tangled in its coat.
A sturdy grey toll dog with brass collar, blank customs tag and worn harness.
A crow with slate feathers dissolving into pale fog at the tips.
A living fraudulent market crier, striped waistcoat, worn top hat, empty sales tray and raised hand.
entities.defeatMeaning: drops tray and flees to the right, alive

entities.description: A walking weathered boundary milestone with ambiguous abstract arrow grooves, no text.
A wagon driver shadow with broad hat and loose reins, smoky feet.
A lonely toll collector without a bridge, long coat, coin cup and portable barrier pole.
The Land Surveyor: towering long-legged surveyor in a weathered coat, brass measuring wheel, dividers and chain, counts steps.
The Sleeping Coach: haunted enclosed horse carriage full of peacefully sleeping passengers, shuttered windows, skeletal wooden undercarriage, no gore.
